name: Cheap Rerolls
description: Rerolling the shop costs 1 gold instead of 2.

name: Volatile
description: Units explode when they die, dealing 25% of their max HP as damage to adjacent enemies.

name: Loot Rain
description: Loot orbs appear every round instead of every second round.

name: Second Wind
description: Every unit comes back once with 40% of its max HP after being defeated.

name: Glass Cannons
description: All units deal 40% more damage but have 25% less max HP.

name: Mana Surge
description: Units start every fight with 50% of their mana.

name: Head Start
description: Everyone starts the match at level 4.
